tei:div.tei:p: tu la'i bla ma'i 'phags bod pod phreng 25da༅༅/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//dpyad zhib pa/dge 'dan rab gsal/ma'ikhriyozas thawā ṇa dbus bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang /nang lo 3543 phyi lo 1999
ra༅༅/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

tu la'i bla ma'i 'phags bod pod phreng 25zhu chen pa/zam gdong sprul sku/dpar thengs dang po/phyi lo 1999deb grangs 550blu yon/rgyab legs la sgor 80 00rgyab zhan la skor 5000dpar skran gyi bdag dbang /dpar skrusna gyi bdag dbang cha tshang wā ṇa dbus bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang la yod/dpar skran pa/wā ṇa dbu༄ bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang /wā ṇa shi khram da 4ra khang du dpar 'debs zhus/

dpar skrun pa'i ched brjod/dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang byon pa'i 'phags yul gyi snyan ngag mkhan chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing ni/ 'phags yul tsam du ma yin par bod gangs can gyi ljongs su yang snyan ngag kun gyi yang rtser rtsis pa zhig yin te/ co ne blo bzang rgya mtsho'i spel mar bstod pa las/snyan ngag kun gyi rgyal po 'khri shing gi /shing rta'i 'phang lo g.yos pa'i bshul lam du//deng dus skye bo'i rgyu 'phrul zad pa na/ /grib ma gnyis pa'i grogs bcas 'gro ba su/ / zhes gsungs shing / rang re kha ba can gyi ljongs su rgya gar gyi paṇḍita chen po larshamikar dang bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po shong dpang rnam gnyis kyi bka' drin las ngo mtshar can gyi gzhung 'di lta bu rang skad du mjal rgyu'i skal bzang thob/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang chos rje sa paṇa gyis bstan bcos 'di la gsan bsam thog ma mdzad pa nas bzung rim pas 'chad nyan 'go tshugs te mchan 'grel dang bskyar zhib sogs kyi rnam gzhag mdzad pa sogs 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i bar dar rgyas legs par byung zhing /dus phyis su'ang mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel sogs kyis gzhung 'di nyid gnad che bar gzigs te bskyar zhib mi nyung ba zhig mdzad 'dugad lam dge 'dun rab gsal lags kyis byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo zhes pa'i

711 1dpyad rtsom zhig mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod kyi rtsal gyi sgo nas deng rabs kyi dpyad tshul gyi lugs dang mthun pa zhig brtsams 'dug pas da lta'i mkhas pa rnams dgyes pa'i gnas su gyur cing / 'byung 'gyur gyi mkhas pa rnams la mig dper 'os pa zhig tu snang / 'di lta bu'i mkhas pa'i bya ba bzang po la 'jug par spro ba brtas shing bsngags brjod kyang yod/byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo 'di nyid gtsug lag slob khang gi tā la'i bla ma'i 'phags bod pod phreng khongs dpar skrun thub pas don gnyer can mang por phan thog rgya gang che yong ba'idang / gzhung 'di'i 'chad nyan chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnas pa'i re smon bcas/ wā ṇa dbus bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag slob khang gi nges ston pa zam gdong pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis/ phyi lo 1998 7 11 tshos 11 la bris pa dge'o//

ngasasha/zang skyongang/dpa ra skrun pa'i ched brjod/ sto11 dpyad zhib pa'i ched brjod/ 51 'gyur rtsom rtogs brjod khag gcig la dpyad pa/sngon gleng / 1rtogs brjod kyi go don/ 3'gyur rtsom rtogs brjod khag gcig gi 'gyur dus bshad pa/ 5'gyur rtsom rtogs brjod khag gcig gi ngo spyod/ 8'brel casad 'ga' zhig la dpyad pa/'gyur rtsom snyan ngag gi 'phel rom spyir bstan pa/ 20rtogs brjod rtsom rig gi 'phel rim/ 27rtogs brjod du 'khod pa'i gtam rgyud kyi byung ba/ 28rtogs brjod rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus/ 31rtogs brjod dzi ltar brtsams tshul/ 35rtogs brjod bod du bsgyur tshul/ 39shong ston gyi rnam thar / 46

kṣiṃrtogs brjod dngos bstan pa/mtshan byang dang gzhung tshad skor/ 50brjod bya'i go rim skor/ 52yal 'dab kyi dpe mtshon bstan pa/ 56yal 'dab rnams chos skor gang du gtogs pa'i tshul bshad pa/ 66rtogs brjod kyi sgya rtsal skor/rtogs brjod kyi rtsomanya rtsal spyir bstan pa/ 71rtogs brjod kyi rtsom lus skor gleng ba/ 74rtogs brjod kyi rtsom rtsal bye brag tu bstan pa/ 82rtogs brjod kyi rtsom 'gros bskyar zhib/ 96rtsom rig shugs rkyen skor/rtogs brjod kyi 'chad nyan 'phel rim/ 102rtogs brjod la mchan 'grel byon rigs/ 103rtogs brjod la las snon byas rigs/ 105

dpyad zhib pa'i ched brjod/ rang re'i pha yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rig pa'i gnas sna tshogs shig dar cing / de dag gi khrod lhan ngag gi 'bro rtsom byed tshul 'dis kyang bstan bcos rigs mang po zhig la khyab nas yod la/ de yang bod du yi ge ma byung ba'i yar sngon nam yang na bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs la mtshon na/ bod mis tshog sbyor sdeb kyi las rigs 'di la gces nas dper na rgyal pos srid don gyi gtam bshad gnang skabs kyang mgur glu spyad yod pa dang / mgur glu de yang dpe don sbyor ba sogs las grub par byas nas gang ltar ngag tshog gi bgrod lam de ga (ligs che gnang yod pa ches gsal la/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go tshugs pa nas bzung lo chen rin bzang dang sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs kyis tha snyad rig gnas zhes snyan ngag 'bri rtsom bya tshul gyi rig gnas 'di dag gal cher bzung nas gtsigs 'dzin gnang ba'i lag rjes su snyan ngag 'bri rtsom byed pa'i dus tshod gsar pa zhig shar zhing / snyan ngag me long lta bu'i snyan ngag sbyong byed kyi gzhung lugs shig kyang mgo nag bod rigs 'di'i skad yig thog byung ba sogs yin/ de nas rim gyis lad chos byed pa dang gong 'phel du gtong ba sogs kyi thabs lam las bod kyi snyan ngag 'bri rtsom gyi srol mang po zhig rtogs brjod dang rnam thar/ lo rgyus chos 'byung / tha na nang rig pa dang tshad ma rig pa sogs kyi gzhung lugs 'chad pa'i che na yang bar skabs kyi ngal gso'i tshogs bcad sogs kyi nang khyab yod pa yin/

511 'on kyang snyan ngag de dang de'am/ bstan bcos de dang de'i 'bri rtsom gyi rnam pa la dpyad zhib kyis ngo bo 'tshol ba dang mtshan nyid 'tshol ba/ mtshan gzhi 'tshol ba/ mkhas pa snga ma'i bstan bcos khag gi 'bri rtsom gnang tshul la lad zlos byas yod med sogs kyi bskyar zhib lam srol zhig ma byung bar snang zhing /lhag don snyan ngag tshogs bcad 'di dang de me long ma'i rgyan 'di dang de yin zhes ngos 'dzin byed pa tsam gyis tshom nas/ bod rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan chig gi rim pa yod na yang / de dag me long ma'i rgyan gyi rnam dbye'i khongs su 'tshangs thabs byas pa las de dag gi rnam pa zur 'don byed pa'i dgongs tshul zhig sngon gyi 'bri rtsom pa rnams la ma byung bar snyam/de bas 'dir phran gyis bstan pa snga dar skabs nas bod yig tu 'gyur ba'i rtogs brjod khag 'ga' zhig la dpyad zhib dang 'brel rang blos dpog tshod kyis rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi skor la phyogs yongs nas nyams zhib byed khul bgyis yod pa 'di ni/ brtse ba'i slob dpon mkhas dbang zam gdong rin po che mchog gi thugs brtse'i slob ston 'og gus par lnga ṇa bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du bod kyi rtso ma rig lo rgyus la bskyar zhib byed pa'i bgo skal bzang po thob pa'i skabs su/ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi rgyu char dmigs nas bris pa yin yang / thog ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i dpyad bsdur re zung byas pa 'di dag rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi khrod du 'jog dgos shar che tshog tshogs mang drags nas don gyi 'bras bu sgrib par 'gyur ba sogs gnod byed 'ga' yang rang bzhin gyis mthong zhing / lar nas 'di nyid logs su dpar skrun gyi go skabs shig 'grig che

ya111 rang nyid kyi ngal ba 'bras med du ma song ba'i khar las dang po ba re zung la phan pa yang srid snyam nas wā ṇa bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi dpar skrun sde tshan la phul ba yin/deb chung 'di zhu sgrig skabs su rogs phan gnang ba'i grogs po tsho dang dpar skrun mthun 'gyur gnang mkhan bcas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang / dpyad zhib pa rang nyid la mtshon na mthong thos kyis gzhung lugs la 'jug pa'i byang goms chung dbang gis 'gal 'dzol ci yod mkhyen ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar snying nas 'chags so//'dir smras pa/nang pa'i gzhung lugs cung zad shes pa dang //rig pa'i gnas la shin tu dga' ba dang //bstud mar 'bad pa bsten pa'i mthu ldan pas//rtog pa'i ri mo 'di 'dra grub par byas//kha bshad mkhas shing lag len nyung ba dang //khyed nyid gzigs shing rang nyid mi gzigs pa'i//spyan ras cher ma'i rtse mo rno ba la//phan du re ba'i 'dun pa ring nas brlag/

519deng sang mgo ser mgo nag sna tshogs kyis//mes po'i shul rjes pad ma'i lo 'dab la//mi gtsang ri mo'i tshon gyi g.yul 'gyed pa//'di ko de mur lhags na snying khams na//thol byung gtam du spel ba'i blo spobs gcig/shar phyogs nub phyogs bsres pa'i bya spyod gnyis//rang lugs gzhan lugs med pa'i 'khyam po gsum// gangs can rig pa'i dgra bo yin pa'ang tshor//shes nas smras pa'i tshog skam gyong po 'dis//ma shes smra ba'i lce la mdud pa rgyobs//ye nas shes pa'i lce la dag pa stsol//mi 'dod rgya yan pa la ther 'don gyis//zhes drang bor zhu ba'i gyod tshog 'ga' dang bcas rab gsal gyis 1995lor wā khāe bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du sdod skabs bris pa dge'o// //

dmo༅/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo/mi rtog mkhyen pa dar mas shes bya'i shugs/ /rdzogs par zos pa'i dga' bdes yid drangs te/ /'jig rten mig tu 'od brgya'i zer 'gyed pa/ /gang zhig bdag blo'i dad pa'i snyim par rtson/ /zhes kun rtog ri mo'i 'gyur ba zhig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir bod yig thog 'gyur ba'i rtogs brjod rtsom yig khag gcig gi 'grel bshad sngon du btang nas/ byang chub sems pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing gi sko' phyomador tsam zhu bar bya ba la/'gyur rtsom rtogs brjod khag gcig la dpyad pa/ sngon gleng /bod kyi rtogs brjod rtsom rig gi thog ma'i dus rabs ni 'gyur yig rtogs brjod kyi dus tshogs la ngos 'dzin byas pa yin/ de yang ska pa dpal brtsegs dang zhang ye shes sde sogs kyis thog mar rtogs brjod rtsom rig bod kyi yig thog tu spel ba'i skabs der/ rtogs brjod rtsom rig la dmigs bsal

2 rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo/snyan ngag gi nyams gang yang bton med pa dang / rim gyis phyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis pa tsam la slebs pa'i che yang rtogs brjod rtsom rig la bcad lhug spel mar byas pa 'ga' re byung ba las snyan ngag gi gson nyams 'bur du bton pa mi snang / yin na yang brjod bya'i cha nas skabs babs mi sna gtso bo de'i yon tan gyi rigs shig rtsal du 'don pa'i rnam pa tsam zhig rtogs brjod 'gyur rtsom sngon ma de dag gi khyad chos su yod par snang / phyis su shong ston gyis dpag bsam 'khri shing bsgyur ba des rtogs brjod 'gyur rtsom la snyan ngag gi gson nyams slebs par byas yod/ de ni phal cher bod kyi rtogs brjod rtsom rig snyan ngag gi 'dzig rten du slebs pa'i gom pa dang po yin pa dang / rtogs brjod rtsom rig de snyan ngag ma yin pa nas snyan ngag yin pa la 'pho 'gyur byas pa'i dus rabs kyi bar mtshams shig kyang yin par snang ngo //gong gsal rgyu mtshan de 'dra la brten nas skabs 'dir lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi rtogs brjod rtsom rig gcig dang snyan ngag rang bzhin gyi rtogs brjod rtsom rig gcig bcas 'phel rim gnyis kyi dbye mtshams phyes yod/ lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi rtogs brjod rtsom rig ces pa ni rtogs brjod rtsom rig gang zhig la lo rgyus kyi rnam pa shas cher yod pa de rigs la ngos 'dzin byas yod/ de bzhin rtogs brjod rtsom rig gang zhig la stan ngag gi rnam pa shas cher yod na de snyan ngag rang bzhin gyi rtogs brjod rtsom rig yin par cha bzhag yod/ yang rtogs brjod rtsom rig dang rnam pa 'dra ba'i rnam thar sogs la rtsom pa pos rtogs brjod ces mtshan sbyar med tsho de rtogs brjod rtsom rig gi khongs su

'gyur rtsom rtogs brjod khag gcig la dpyad pa/ 3btang med/ de'i dgos pa ni rtogs brjod rtsom rig gi sa mtshams dang 'gyur mtshams gsal ba'i ched yin/dang po/ rtogs brjod kyi go don/rtogs brjod kyi skad dod a ba dā na zhes pa de bya ba rlabs chen nam byas rjes lta bu zhig la da yod dbyin hin tshog mdzod khag tu 'grel bshad gnang 'dug lo chen rin chen bzang po (958—1055)dang paṇḍita padma ka ra bam gnyis kyis bsgyur ba'i ku la'i rtogs pa brjod pa zhes pa la cha bzhag nas bshad na/de ni chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi sras shig la bya ku khāe la'i mig dang 'dra ba'i spyan yod pas mtshan la yang ku khāe la zhes btags shing nar son te btsun mo dang bcas rol pa'i skabs shig la gnas brtan grags pas chos bstan rjes rgyal sras chos la yid phyogs shing sgrub pa nyams len la gzhol bas bden tshog grub pa'i lo rgyus shig bshad yod/ de ltar na rtogs brjod ces pa yang lo rgyus dang 'jug pa gcig par mngon/ 'on kyang lo rgyus kyis byung ba rnams cha snyom por 'chad pa dang rtogs brjod kyis brjod bya'i mi sna de'i yon tan rigs rtsal du bton nas 'chad pa lta bu'i bar khyad cig yod par snang / 'di'i nang rtsom 'gros dmigs bsal ba zhig slebs yod pa ni brjod bya'i don gcig thog mar tshog lhug gis bshad zin rjes yang bskyar don de nyid tshogs bcad du drangs te bskyar bshad byas yod pa dper na/ 66de nas gzhon nus gnas brtan gyi rkang pa gnyis la btud de smras pa/ gnas brtan ci zhig bka' bstsal/ gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ ku khāe la mig cani mi rtag pa'o zhes yid la gyis shig yang smras pa/

4 rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo/gang du 'gro mang rjes su chags gyur nas// mi phan thob pa'i las rnams byed pa yi//mig ni rab g.yo sdug bsngal stong ldan par//rtag tu so sor rtog byas ku khāe la//zi 1 zhes 'byung ba lta bu'o// 'gyur yig khrod du yod pa'i rtogs brjod thams cad 'di 'dra ba'i bcad lhug spel ma min la khyad par phag mo'i rtogs brjod lta bu ni lo rgyus sam gtam rgyud kyi rnam pa dang ha cang 'dra/yang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rjod byed bka' yi chos 'khor la sde tshan nam yan lag kha shas su dbye 'byed byas te gsung rab yan lag dgu'am bcu gnyis bgrang ba'i khrod du yang rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde zhes sde tshan zhig zur du phyes pa ni gang zag gang yang rung ba zhig gi nyams rtogs sam yon tan rigs rtsal du bton nas brjod pa'i sde tshan zhig la btags pa'i ming yin nam snyam/de ltar 'gyur yig tu 'khod pa'i rtogs brjod khag gi brjod bya la bsam gzhigs kyis rtogs brjod ces pa'i ming don la go ba blangs na/ rtogs brjod ces pa ni gang zag gang zhig gis chos nyams su blangs pa la brten nas dge legs kyi mtshan ma 'bras bu bzang po thob pa'i tshul rtsal du bton nas ston pa'i bstan bcos shig gi ming du gyur yod/ 'on kyang rtogs brjod de bod kyi mkhas pa'i smyug rtse nas 'phro skabs brjod bya dmigs bsal du bton pa tsam 1 sde dge bstan 'gyur/ 'dul ba/ su/ shog grangs 339 ba 1 na gsal/

'gyur rtsom rtogs brjod khag gcig la dpyad pa/ 5gyis ma tshom par rjod tshog kyang rtsal du thon pa zhig dgos kyi yod pa 'dra/ des na rtogs brjod ces pa ni gang zag dmigs bsal ba zhig gi mdzad rjes khag snyan ngag gi tshog rtsal spyad nas ston pa'i bstan bcos sheg la ngos 'dzin byas chog mod/ 'on kyang go don des 'gyur yig rtogs brjod /bag dang bod rang rtsom khrod kyi rgyal mchog lnga pa dang ta ra na tha'i rang rnam lta bu la mi khyab pa 'dra'o//gnyis pa/ 'gyur rtsom rtogs brjod khag gcig gi 'gyur dus bshad pa/lo rgyus bshad skabs lo tshogs nges 'drongs shig 'tshol rgyu gnad du che yang / 'og nas 'byung ba'i rtogs brjod khag la mtshon na bsgyur ba'i lo tshogs nges gtan zhi ga zhu rgyu shin tu dka'/ de yang 'gyur byang du bsgyur mkhan tsam las 'gyur dus mi gsal ba dang gcig bsgyur mkhan lo tsā ba'i 'khrungs gshegs lo tshogs rnyed dka' ba dang gnyis/ dus skabs 'di'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus dag na yang kha gsal nges 'drongs shig mi snang ba dang gsum bcas la brten nas skabs 'dir dus mtshungs sgrig pa'i rtog pas tshod dpag bya rgyu tsam bgo skal du thob/ bu ston rin po che'i chos 'byung las/ 66bod kyi lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun dang / chos kyi snang ba dang / bande nam mkha' dang / sgro rin chen sde dang /rnam par mi rtog pa dang / shākya 'od la sogs pas lo tsā byas te chos mang po bsgyur/mi lha zhes btsan po khri srong lde btsan skabs bsam yas gtsug lag khang 2 bod nas dpar ba'i deb gzugs par ma/ shog grangs/ 187 par gsal/

6 rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo/bzhengs te sgra bsgyur 'chad spel gyi sde mang po btsugs pa'i gnas tshul bshad skabs lo tsā ba shākya 'od ces pa'i mtshan byung / deb sngon du/ 66jo bo rje la lo tsā ba sngar gyi de dag dang / shākya 'od dang lha 3 zhes dang / bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya nas lo brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa gcig 'das rjes kyi chu pho rta (1042)la jo bo rje bod du phebs/ de'i che sgra bskyar mar pas lo so gcig lon/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos lo dgu lon/ ༄ lo tsā ba leng 'brog 'gos gsum dang /stag lo gzhon tshul/ 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od/ khu dngos grub/ gyi jo che ba'i 'od zer rnams kyang yodag zhes 'byung bas/ dza bo bod du phebs pa'i dus tsam na yod pa'i lo tsā ba seng kur shākya 'od ces pa zhig snang ba de la yig cha 'gar 'bro shākya 'od ces kyang 'byung / de ltar shākya 'od snga phyi gnyis las phyi ma 'dis dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dus dkyil tsam 04 lo tsā'i las byed bzhin pa gsal zhing / khong gis stag rna'i rtogs brjod bskyar ba la lo chen rin bzang gis 'gyur bcos byas pa 'gyur byang du 'byung bamubre lo chen zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs bsgyur bar mngon/ khong gi las rogs paṇḍi ta a dzi ta shrī rbha dra zhes pa des 'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa bsgur dus kyi las rogs kyang byas 'dug pas rtogs brjod de sgyur mkhan gyi shākya tshed kyang lo tsā ba 'di yin par cha 'jog byas/ dkar chag lhan dkar mar/ 66'brug gi lo 3 deb ther sngon po/ si khron par ma'i deb shog 203 dang lung phyi ma de deb shog 99 par gathagakhab/

'gyur rtsom rtogs brjod khag gcig la dpyad pa/ 7la pho brang lhan dkar na bzhugs pa'i ston/4 sgra bsgyur gyi ban de dpal brtsegs dang / ban de klu'i dbang po la sogs pas ri 5 zhes dang / sgra sbyor bam po gnyis par/ 66rta'i lo la btsad po khri lde srong btsan pho brang gi'i 'on cang rdo na bzhugs/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsārya dzi na mi tra dang / su renanasdu bo ddhi dang / shī lend+ra bo ddhi dang / dā na shī la dang / bo dhi mi tra dang /336 zhes 'byung bas paṇḍita dzi na mi tra de khri srong lde btsan dang ral pa can gnyis ku'i skabs bod du bzhugs par mngon/ khri srong lde btsan de phyi lo 790 lor 'khrungs shing 845 lor gshegs pa dang / khri ral pa can phyi lo 855 lor 'khrungs shing 901 lor 'das par che tan zhabs drung bas rang lugs su bzhed/phyi lo 835 shing pho 'brug gi lo la bkod pa'i dkar chag lhan dkar mar gang po sogs kyi rtogs brjod brgya pa dang bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs brjod/ phag mo'i rtogs brjod/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes ldan gyi mdo bcas kyi mtshan byung bas rtogs brjod de bzhi khri srong gi sku stod tsam la bsgyur zin pa rigs pas grub cing / paṇḍita dzi na mi tra dang mnyam du lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sde dang de ba tsan dra ste lha'i che ba gnyis kyis kyang rtogs brjod bsgyur gnang 'dug4 'di'i 'brug lo de phyi lo 825 pa shing pho 'brug yin pa bstan rtsis kun btus kyi shog grangs 134 nga/ra gsal/5 sde dge bstan 'gyur/ sna tshogs/ jo 394 ba 7 par gsal/du sdi dge bstan 'gyur/ sna tshogs/ co/ 131 ba 1 par gsal/

'brel yod 'ga' zhig la dpyad pa/dang po/'gyur rtsom snyan ngag gi 'phel rim spyir bstan pa/de yang bod du bstan pa phyo dar gyi dus mgor byung ba'i mkhas pa grags chen lo chen rin chen bzang po (970—1067)dang 'brog mi lo tsā ba shakyu ye shes/(993—1077)mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros (1012—1092)sogs kyi brtsams chos dang 'gyur chos dag gi khrod 'gyur rtsom snyan ngag gi nyams las drangs pa ches dkon zhing / mi la ras pa'i (1040—1123)mgur rtsom sogs kyi rtsom 'ga' zhig kyang de mtshungs su snang ngo // 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi jo bstod dang bslab bya sogs kyi gsung gas su yang kha shas la mgur rtsom gyi nyams yod cing / kha shas la sgra 'dra mtshungs spel ba'i sgra rgyan dang dpe don gyi nyams btod pa'i don rgyan gyi rnam pa yod pa yang snang mod gzhi rtsa'i cha nas rtsom 'gros de dag 'gyur rtsom snyan ngag las rnam pa gzhan zhig chags 'dugashong ston gyis phyi lo 1269 tsam la rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing de snyan ngag gi nyams phul du byung ba'i bstan bcos 'di 'dra zhig tu bsgyur gnang ba de ni nges par du gzhi rtsa'i shes yon mi dman pa zhig dang 'brel ba dam zab yod snyam/ de yang shong ston kho rang la snyan ngag bsgyur rtsal las 'gongs pa'i snyan ngag rtsom rtsal yod dgos pa ma zad/ khong las rtsom rtsal mtho ba'am khong dang rtsom rtsal mnyam pa'i gang zag kyang mi nyung ba zhig yod

'brel yod 'ga' zhig la dpyad pa/ 21dgos kyi red snyam/ dus skabs 'di'i yar sngon du byung ba'i bod kyi mkhas pa tsho'i brtsams gzhung khrod 'gyur rtsom snyan ngag gi nyams yod pa 'tshol zhib byas dus thog ma lta bur sa skya na rim gyi gsung las mngon gyi 'dug dus rabs brgyad pa dang dgu pa'i skabs su bsgyur ba'i 'gyur gzhung dag gi khrod du tshogs su bcad pa'i bstod tshogs dang gzhung lugs gang mang zhig snang yang de dag la snyan ngag gi bro nyams thon pa de tsam mi snang /sa skya ba na rim gyi gsung las thog mar sa chen kun dga' snying po'i (1092—1158)gsung 'bum khrod du byung / sa chen kun snying la tshog rtsal gyis rnam dpyod bla bral du mtshon pa'i snyan ngag sgya rtsal lhan skyes su mnga' ba yin nam gang ltar khong gis rang nyid kyi yab 'arten dkon mchog rgyal po (1034 1102) las sgra dang sdeb sbyor sogs gsan 'dug cing / yab dkon mchog rgyal pos ni 'brog mi lo tsā ba dang 'gos lo tsā ba khug pa lhas btsas/ rma lo tsā ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba sogs bla mar bsten te mkhas pa'i yon tan la sbyangs 'dug (ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags 'di las sa chen nyid kyis kyang chos gsan 'dug)sa chen gyis snyan rtsom bstod tshogs kyi gas su bla ma bi rū pa'i bstod pa dang zhang ston chos 'bar la bstod pa gnyis snang ba la 'bur du thon pa'i tshog rtsal mngon 'dug de yang dpe mtshon tsam drangs na zhang ston la bstod pa las/yon tan mchog mnga' gzhan la phan pa'i thugs rje can/ /ting 'dzin mchog brnyes nyid kyi don yang mthar phyin pa/ /

22 rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo/dam pa mchog chos chos gnyis grub pas mngon shes dang / /rdzu 'phrul mchog 'bar sbas pa'i brtul zhugs can la 'dud/ /1ces bkod yod/ 'di la ni drang bor brjod pa'i rgyan nyams ldan zhing rkang pa bzhi ku'i tshog 'bru gsum pa la mchog mchog ces slebs par byas pas zung ldan gyi nyams kyang thon yod/ da dung 'di'i nang dmigs bsal gyi nyams shig slebs par byas yod pa ni tshog rkang phyed phyi rim gnyis kyis bstod yul gyi mtshan chos 'bar zhes pa'i ming 'bru gnyis thon yod pas mtshan spel sgra rgyan gyi nyams kyang yod pa'o//(mtshan spel sgra rgyan zhes pa ni phran gyis gsar 'dogs byas pa'i ming yin/ de yang gdags gzhi'i smor la bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rim nang brjod bya'i dngos po gang zhig gi ming 'bru rnams tshogs bcad nang bkrams te rtsom 'bri ba'i lugs srol zhig dar 'dug pa de lta mod da phan ming 'dogs mkhan byung mi 'dug)sa chen kun dga' snying po'i sras ni slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo (1142 1182)yin/ slob dpon 'dis rgya sgom tshul khrims grags la springs pa'i yi ge zhig nang / tsa yang bla chen gyi bstod pa/ dge bshes gnyaḍa dang / gnyan phul byung la dbyar phu ma gsum gyis zhus nas bgyis pa de la/ snyan ngag gi rgyan tshang che chung gnyis yod pa khyed kyi phyag tu byung mchi/mi lha zhes 'byung ba 'di la gzhigs na dus skabs 'di tsam nas snyan ngag gi rgyan tshang ma tshang gi rnam gzhag cig byung 1 sa skya bka' 'bum/ ku shog grangs/ 3 ba 4 na gsal/ri sa skya bka' 'bum/ ga shog grangs/ 78 ba 3 na gsal/

'grel yod 'ga' zhig la dpyad pa/ 23'dug kyang / de ni don rgyan so lnga tshang ma tshang zhes pa lta bu min par snyan ngag gi rgyan nyams ldan pa'i don la go dgos pa 'dra/ slob dpon 'di'i gsung na yang bstod pa snyan ngag mang po zhig yod pa las 'dir dpe mtshon tsam drangs na/brgyud pa dang bcas pa la gsol ba 'debs pa zhes pa las/gang thugs kun nas dga' ba'i dpal mnga' ba/ /gang gsung snying po mchog gi lam ston cing / /gang sku blta bas mi ngoms mjes pa'i mchog /skyes chen bla ma'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /3zhes 'byung ba lta bur mtshon na tshog rkang snga ma gsum gyi tshog 'bru dang po rnams la sgra rgyan gyi nyams yod cing / de nas kun dga' snying po zhes pa'i mtshan 'bru rnams mtshan spel sgra rgyan gyi rnam par spel yod/slob da pon bsod nams rtse mo'i gcung rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan (1147—1216) gyi gsung 'bum khrod kyi bstod tshogs su yang rtsom rigs 'di'i gas shin tu mang zhing de yang bla ma'i bstod pa'i skabs shig 'di ltar/khyed nyid dam pa rnams kyi rigs 'khrungs nas/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i dpal gyis nyer 'tsho ba/ /don gyi snying po rnam grol mchog brnyes pa'i/ /blo gros chen po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /43 sa skya bka' 'bum/ ga shog grangs/ 75 ba sta na gsal/4 sa skya bka' 'bum/ ma shog grangs/ 155 ba cu na gsal/

24 rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo/ces pa lta bu dang / yang de'i rjes su sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan (1182 1251)mchog ni ngag gi rig rtsal la ci dgar dbang bsgyur ba'i ngag gi dbang phyug rla bral zhig ste khong gi 'gyur rtsom snyan ngag gi rtsom gshis la ni 'jam sha dod cing rang bzhin gyis zor yangs pa'i dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan yod/'dir dpe mtsho na tsam bkod na tshad ma rigs gter gyi mjug rtsom du/skye ba skye ba rnams su yang dang yang //mkhas pa mkhas pa rnams su sngon sbyangs pas//che 'dir lan re zung re thos tsam gyis//gzhung ༷/gas kun shes kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal//phyogs las rnam rgyal phyogs glang grags pa'i gzhung //mdo dang rnam 'grel de 'grel dang bcas rnams//legs par rtogs shing rtog ge'i tshul shes nas//yang dag rigs mtshon rigs pa'i gter 'di bsgrubs//5zhes tshog rkang re re la chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi nyams slebs par byas yod pa 'dis mtshon thub/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas (1235—1280)sa paṇa las rig pa'i gnas gsan te shes bya'i gnas la mkhyen pa'i stobs rgyas shing / khyad par sa paṇa gyis tha snyad rig pa'i gnas zhes sgra dang gtan tshogs/ snyan ngag dang tshog gi rgyan/ rol mo la sogs pa la gtsigs chen mdzad pa'i bka' drin la brten du sarjeX kha'a'abum da shog grangs/ 34 ba nga na gsal /

'brel yod 'ga' zhig la dpyad pa/ 25nas 'gro mgon 'phags pa 'di bzhin rtsom rtsal gyi 'phur shugs rdzogs pa'i mkha' lding gzhon nu zhig tu gyur te rtsom rig nam mkha'i mthongs nas 'phur lding gi rol gar ci yang bsgyar bar mdzad/ de'i tshul ni 'gro mgon 'phags pas phyi lo 1250 tswar bris pa'i yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i rab tu byed pa zhes pa dang / yang ka sogs sum cu la spel ba zhes pa'i ka rtsom snyan ngag khag gnyis dang / yi ge'i sbyor tshul zhes pa dbyangs nges pa'i bya dka' ba sogs kyis mtshon zhing / khyad par du phyi lo 1259 lor bris pa'i snyan ngag bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes pa de bzhin deng dus snyan ngag mkhas pas kyang dzi bzhin thon thabs bral ba'i tshog rtsal ldan zhing me long ma'i gzhang la byang chab pa'i rtsom mkhan gyi nyams dod por yod pa ba cusogs kyi khyad chos ldan 'dug de yang dpe mtshon tsam drangs na/tshog gi sdeb sbyor sbyor ba'i tshul la tshul bzhin shes pa'i shes ldan zhing //don gyi rin chen chen po'i chen pos ches cher mdzes byed sna tshogs kyis//gang blo'i khang mdzes mdzes par rab spras spros pas spros pa'i yid dbang phyir//gzhan gyi snyan dngags ngag gi dpal 'phrog 'phrog byed yid rab 'phrog pa sbyar//6zhes chod cing ma chod pa dang gnas gzhan na yod pa sogs kyi sgra rgyan bsres nas ngag gi 'khyug cha bton yod pa lta bu yin la/ snyan bstod 'di'i rtsom byang du 'di ltar/ 66tshul 'di ni rkang pa thung ngu dang / ring po dang / shin tu ring co sa skya bka' 'bum/ ba shog grangs/ 107 na nga na gsal/

26 rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo/po rnams spel zhing 'byung bas rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi phreng ba lta bu zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor yin la 7 zhes rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi phreng ba lta bu'i sdeb sbyor zhes ming 'dogs mdzad 'dugade ltar sa chen kun dga' snying po nas bzung shong ston gyis rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing bsgyur ba'i bar gyi mi lo brgya phrag gcig dang phyed tsam gyi ring la sa skya gong ma rnam lngas tha snyad rig gnas kyi bla srog dam por 'jus nas gso skyong gnang zhing / 'jig rten na ga'an dring mi 'jog pa'i rnam dpyod kyi ngar shugs spyad de 'gyur yi/ga dang 'gyur khungs kyi snyan ngag la phyi mo byas pa'i rtsom rig ngag rtsal gyi rnam pa mang po gsar btod mdzad/ rnam pa des bod kyi lo rgyus steng 'gyur rtsom snyan ngag la mchongs bskyod kyi stobs shugs bstsal ba dang mnyam du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i snyan pa'i grags pa lo rgyus steng nyams pa med pa'i mang gzhi btings pa red/ de yang khong chos thog mar drang bor brjod pa'i tshog gi rgyan la sgra rgyan gyi rnam pa bsres btab nas rig pa'i 'khyug rtsal thon par byas shing / rjes su rim gyis dpe rgyan dang gzugs rgyan/ rab rtog sogs 'khyog por brjod pa'i snyan ngag gi nyams thon par byas te 'gyur rtsom snyan ngag gi dbu 'phang dgung la btegs pa yin no//de lta bu'i rtsom rtsal dang rtsom 'gros kyi lam ston dang lag len 'og shong ston gyis phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan ngag gi chun po rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di bzhin gsar du bsgyur thub pa byung zhing / de yang rang nyid la skyes ga saskyadzra ku'a'abum ba shog grangs/ 105 ba / na gsal/

'brel yod 'ga' zhig la dpyad pa/ 27sbyangs rtsal gyis thob pa'i rtsom rtsal bkol nas bod kyi skad yig nang du slebs pa'i rtogs brjod kyi lus yongs rdzogs snyan ngag gi rang bzhin du bsgrabs yod/'di ni rnam pa gcig tu na shong ston gyis gsar rtsom gnang ba'i gyen ngag gi bstan bcos shig kyang yin te/ rgya gar skad kyi snyan ngag gang zhig bod skad du bsgyur ba tsam min par bod kyi ngag rtsal rang bzhin ldan pa'i bstan bcos shig tu bsgrabs pas so//ba gnyis pa/rtogs brjod rtsom rig gi 'phel rim/bod du bstan pa phyo dar skabs su byung ba'i gsung rtsom yod rigs kyi mkhas pa'i khrod nas 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas (1004—1064)yab sras kyi gsung du bla ma'i bstod pa 'ga' re las rtogs brjod rtsom yig yod par mi snang zhing / sa chen kun snying gi gsung du yang bstod pa 'ga' re dang slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi lo rgyus lta bu rnam thar dang cha 'dra ba 'ga' re snang mod de dag sngar yod rtogs brjod rtsom yig la ma dpe byas nas bris pa zhig min par sems/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung du bla ma'i bstod pa khyod nyid ma zhes pa zhig snang ba de ni rnam thar dang bstod pa'i gzhi mthun tsam las rtogs brjod kyi khongs su mi gtogs snyam/ da dung bla ma sa skya ba chen po'i rnam thar ces pa zhig yod pa de ni brjod bya dang rjod byed gang thad nas rtogs brjod 'gyur rtsom khag dang rnam pa 'dra yang rtsom pa pos de la rtogs brjod ces ming sbyor mdzad mi 'dug de bzhin sa paṇa gyi gsung bstod tshogs dang rnam thar khag

28 rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpyad pa'i gtam rtog pa'i ri mo/la yang rtogs brjod rtsom gras su btang ba mi snang la 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang mar mi yab sras sob/sa kyi gsung du yang rtogs brjod ces ming btags pa'i rtsom yig gang yang mi snang /des na dus rabs bcu gnyis pa yan la byung ba'i rtogs brjod 'gyur rtsom khag gis bod kyi rtsom pa por rtogs brjod rtsom yig 'bri rgyur skul slong byas med pa ma zad de dag gis bod kyi rtsom rig gi 'phel phyogs la shugs rkyen gang yang thebs med par mngon no// de tsam gyis skabs 'di'i 'phel rim bshad pa 'thus par byas shing gong du 'gyur rtsom snyan ngag gi 'phel rim bshad pa las kyang phyogs 'di rob tsam zhig shes par nus so//gsum pa/rtogs brjod du 'khod pa'i gtam rgyud kyi byung ba/de yang ji skad du dbyug pa can gyis/ sngon byung gtam las gyur pa 'am//cig shos legs pa la brten pa// zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon byung gi gtam rgyud la phul du byung ba'i tshog rgyan gyis spras te snyan dngags chen po 'di grub pa yin la/ de yang 'dir 'khod pa'i gtam rgyud de dag ni mdo mdzangs blun dang las brgya pa/ rtogs brjod brgya pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' las ci rigs par btus par snang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / 66skyes rabs (bstan 'gyur skyes rabs gras su 'khod pa )'di rnams byang
